subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Investigar e analisar o funcionamento de equipamentos elétricos e/ou eletrônicos e sistemas de automação para compreender as tecnologias contemporâneas e avaliar seus impactos sociais, culturais e ambientais.

components.description_pt: Investigar o funcionamento de equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos usados em tecnologias contemporâneas
components.description_en: Investigate the functioning of electrical and electronic equipment used in contemporary technologies
components.cc_component_description: Explain how patterns in light, sound, or electrical signals can represent and transmit information

components.description_pt: Analisar como sistemas de automação operam em contextos cotidianos e industriais
components.description_en: Analyze how automation systems operate in everyday and industrial contexts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how changes in inputs or outputs affect the behavior of a system

components.description_pt: Avaliar os impactos sociais, culturais e ambientais de tecnologias elétricas e eletrônicas
components.description_en: Evaluate the social, cultural, and environmental impacts of electrical and electronic technologies
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a proposed solution by weighing its social, cultural, and environmental impacts alongside technical criteria

cc_matches.description: Generate and compare multiple solutions that use patterns to transfer information.
When investigating or describing a system, the boundaries and initial conditions of the system need to be defined and their inputs and outputs analyzed and described using models.
When evaluating solutions it is important to take into account a range of constraints including cost, safety, reliability and aesthetics and to consider social, cultural and environmental impacts.
